L’herbe doit être appliquée fraîche sur la peau. Une dose soigneusement étalée permet de traiter environ quatre pieds carrés de brûlures.

It is also known as Spike.

This grass is found chiefly in mild temperate climates, especially in short-grass plains, and is best known in south-western Endor.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains fairly easy to find.

To obtain its properties, it is used by direct application.

The herb must be applied fresh to the skin. One carefully spread dose can treat roughly four square feet of burns.
